versions.localizedDescription:
A manga and webtoon reader for your [Suwayomi](https://suwayomi.org/) server.

### 🚀 Improvements

- Added visible progress while checking the server connection, searching the network and signing in during setup (@aaronbamblett)
- Collapsed **Custom HTTP headers** into an expandable row during setup, showing the number configured (@aaronbamblett)
- Removed unused packages and updated dependencies (@yohanim)

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed large libraries failing to load beyond the first page (@SuperMario22922)
- Fixed setup losing the entered server address and connection result (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Next** doing nothing instead of checking the connection or signing in during setup (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the login form disappearing during sign-in (@aaronbamblett)

A manga and webtoon reader for your [Suwayomi](https://suwayomi.org/) server.

### ✨ New Features

*Accounts need a Suwayomi server with multi-user support, which is not in a Suwayomi release yet. Everything else below works on any current server.*

- Added multi-user accounts so each person can sign in to a Suwayomi server with their own library, downloads and permissions (@aaronbamblett)
- Added an **Account** screen showing your role and permissions, with **Change password** and **Sign out** (@aaronbamblett)
- Added user management so administrators can create accounts and issue a **Registration code** or **Recovery code** (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Inactive account downloads** to remove downloads another account left on this device (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Keep recently-read chapters downloaded** to fetch the next chapter as you cross a chapter boundary (@yohanim)
- Added a **Library update errors** screen that opens from the failed-update notification and lists series that failed during the last library update, each with a **Migrate** button (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Select below** to the chapter multi-select menu (@yohanim)
- Added options to stop keeping chapters downloaded and remove downloaded chapters in the offline picker when selecting multiple library series (@yohanim)
- Completed the Chinese translations for zh, zh-Hans and zh-Hant (@AITNR)

### ⚙️ Changes

- Added confirmation whenever you delete chapters in bulk, with a warning when they will also be removed from this device (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed the library update button to a stop button while an update is running (@aaronbamblett)
- Replaced the Updates summary sheet with the **Library update errors** screen (@aaronbamblett)

### 🚀 Improvements

- Added a spinner that appears as soon as you tap **Download to server** (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Retry all** to the Downloads **Server** tab whenever any download has failed (@aaronbamblett)
- Updated the Browse tab's update count after installing, updating or uninstalling an extension (@aaronbamblett)
- Updated the Updates list to show new entries as a background library check finishes, preserving your place in the list (@yohanim)

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed background downloads skipping series past the first page of a large library (@yohanim)
- Fixed **Keep next N unread** downloading chapters behind your furthest-read position (@yohanim)
- Fixed bulk keep-rule changes only taking effect for overnight downloads after the app was next sent to the background (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed series remaining scheduled for overnight downloads after you removed them from this device (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed bulk keep-rule changes downloading chapters to this device without storing them on the server (@yohanim)
- Fixed inconsistent handling of releases with the same chapter number when marking chapters as read, deleting them or navigating in the reader (@SuperMario22922)
- Fixed overnight downloads stopping when the access token expired (@yohanim)
- Fixed downloads restarting when the notification panel was closed (@yohanim)
- Fixed failures when changing the server address while downloads were registered (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed downloaded chapters being fetched again and storage use being miscounted at desktop launch (@yohanim)
- Fixed background catch-up never retrying chapters it had given up on (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed source filters appearing partially selected before you tapped them (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed tapping a queued or active device download failing to cancel it (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed bulk chapter deletion doing nothing in the web app (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed getting stuck in an unauthorised library by adding a **Signed out** screen that opens connection settings (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the Library failing to refresh when opened during an ongoing library update (@yohanim)
- Fixed signing in appearing to hang forever, by moving the offline library into its account instead of copying every downloaded chapter (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed blank labels throughout the German translation (@DattatreyaReddy)

- Fixed offline downloads and reading progress not carrying over when the library moved into its account (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the Downloads queue header flickering on a slow or unreachable server (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed kept series being dropped from the device when a library timestamp was misread (@yohanim)

A manga and webtoon reader for your [Suwayomi](https://suwayomi.org/) server.

A hotfix for v1.2.0, which would not open on the Linux Flatpak.

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed the Linux Flatpak showing **Tsumiru couldn't start** instead of opening (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed categories added on another device not appearing until the app was restarted (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the storage limit being ignored on Windows (@yohanim)
- Fixed downloads leaving folders behind on Windows when a file was briefly locked (@yohanim)

A manga and webtoon reader for your [Suwayomi](https://suwayomi.org/) server.

### ✨ New Features

- Added **Custom HTTP headers** for servers behind an authentication gateway, Zero Trust guard, or reverse proxy (@Yukaii)
- Added an optional **Internal / LAN URL** alongside your **Server URL**, with an **Active connection** row showing whether you are **Using LAN** or **Using remote** (@SuperMario22922)
- Tapping a series in **On device** now opens **Downloaded chapters**, with **Retry** and **Remove from device** on each row (@ariqpradipa)
- Stalled downloads now show a banner saying why, with a **Retry** button (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Chapter grouping** to the **Updates** filters, with **Collapsed** and **Expanded** modes (@yohanim)
- Added **Download files in the background**, so background checks can fetch chapters instead of only queueing them (@yohanim)
- Added **Keep recently-read chapters downloaded**, which re-downloads keep-window chapters if they go missing (@yohanim)
- Extensions can now be repaired with **Reinstall** (@aaronbamblett)

### ⚙️ Changes

- The **Server** downloads tab is now the same list as **On device**, with a **Queue** header and a page count on the active download (@aaronbamblett)
- The server queue now reorders by long press or the drag handle, and each row has **Retry**, **Cancel**, **Move to top** and **Move to bottom** (@aaronbamblett)
- **Continuous horizontal** reading modes now scroll continuously instead of a page at a time (@yohanim)

### 🚀 Improvements

- Queued downloads that Android refuses to start now stay visible and recoverable instead of disappearing (@aaronbamblett)
- Background downloads can now resume on their own without you reopening the app (@aaronbamblett)
- Pause and Wi-Fi only preferences are kept when downloads recover (@aaronbamblett)
- Switching server or account no longer lets downloads carry on with old credentials (@aaronbamblett)
- Chapters your server cannot produce are now given up on after a few attempts instead of asked for forever (@yohanim)
- Background downloads no longer hang on a dead connection (@yohanim)
- Background warnings and errors now reach the in-app debug log (@yohanim)
- Applying a **Keep offline** rule to several series now shows one continuous progress count (@yohanim)
- Chapters found by a library update now finish downloading without opening the series (@yohanim)
- When a chapter in your **Keep offline** rule cannot be downloaded, the next unread chapter takes its place (@yohanim)
- Library search stays responsive on large libraries (@yohanim)
- Long strips with page cropping on now scroll more smoothly and use less memory (@yohanim)
- The **On device** list no longer stutters while a download is running (@yohanim)
- The library's **On device** badge and filter now update as downloads finish (@yohanim)
- Offline download indicators now appear before the server connection is established (@ariqpradipa)
- Extension errors now show a readable message instead of a wall of code (@aaronbamblett)
- The login and **Basic Auth** dialogs now submit when you press Enter (@aaronbamblett)

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed logins on macOS not surviving a restart (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Simple Login** rejecting valid credentials on Android, iOS and desktop (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Browse** source filters resetting each time you reopened them (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Reset** in the source filters leaving the old results on screen (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed pinch zoom drifting away from the point between your fingers (@yohanim)
- Fixed zooming near the top or bottom of a page pushing it out of view (@yohanim)
- Fixed the webtoon reader jumping to the previous chapter on a small scroll near the top (@yohanim)
- Fixed the webtoon reader loading the next chapter too early on long chapters (@yohanim)
- Fixed returning to the previous chapter landing at the top of a tall page (@yohanim)
- Fixed date headers on **Updates** repeating as you scrolled (@yohanim)
- Fixed chapters read on another device ignoring your delete-while-reading settings (@yohanim)
- Fixed a chapter with no pages spinning as downloading forever (@yohanim)
- Fixed the download notification flashing in a loop for a chapter that fails immediately (@yohanim)
- Fixed the tracker using the wrong setting for chapters you marked read while offline (@yohanim)
- Fixed switching servers leaving the app retrying a sign-in against the old one (@yohanim)
- Fixed a crash when marking several chapters read at once (@yohanim)
- Fixed crashes when deleting a chapter from the server after leaving the screen (@yohanim)
- Fixed a crash loop in the library category tabs (@yohanim)
- Fixed installing an extension from an empty file appearing to succeed on web (@yohanim)
- Fixed the app asking your server for the same chapters twice while catching up on new ones (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Download to server** queueing chapters your server already had (@aaronbamblett)

### 🚀 Improvements

- Downloads now wait for your server to come back before trying again (@aaronbamblett)
- The app now switches to offline mode straight away when your server is unreachable (@aaronbamblett)
- Library covers now appear faster and use less data (@aaronbamblett)
- The download notification now stays on screen and names what stopped the queue (@aaronbamblett)
- The offline banner and its **Refresh** button now appear on series pages (@aaronbamblett)
- Reduced the work your server does while you use the app (@aaronbamblett)

### ⚙️ Changes

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed downloads not resuming when the app was opened while your server was unreachable (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed downloaded chapters opening slowly or not at all offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed categories with nothing downloaded disappearing from the library offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Suggestions** leaving an empty gap when it could not load (@aaronbamblett)
